DEBT AND OTHER COMMITMENTS Summary of Term Debt Obligations In millions December 28, 2025 December 29, 2024 Principal amount of 2025 Term Notes outstanding — 500 Principal amount of 2026 Term Notes outstanding 500 500 Principal amount of 2027 Term Notes outstanding 500 500 Principal amount of 2030 Term Notes outstanding 500 — Principal amount of 2031 Term Notes outstanding 500 500 Unamortized discounts and debt issuance costs ( 11 ) ( 11 ) Net carrying amount of term debt 1,989 1,989 Less: current portion 499 499 Term debt, non-current $ 1,490 $ 1,490 Fair value of term debt outstanding (Level 2) $ 1,977 $ 1,940 Interest expense recognized on our outstanding debt obligations, which included amortization of debt discounts and debt issuance costs, was $ 99 million in 2025 and 2024, respectively, and $ 74 million in 2023. 4.750 % Term Notes due 2030 (2030 Term Notes) On November 25, 2025, we issued $ 500 million aggregate principal amount of 2030 Term Notes. After deducting discounts and issuance costs, we received net proceeds of $ 495 million. The 2030 Notes, which mature on December 12, 2030, accrue interest at a rate of 4.750 % per annum, payable semi-annually on June 12 and December 12 of each year, beginning on June 12, 2026. We may redeem for cash all or any portion of the 2030 Term Notes, at our option, at any time prior to maturity at make-whole premium redemption prices as defined in the form of the notes. 4.650 % Term Notes due 2026 (2026 Term Notes) On September 9, 2024, we issued $ 500 million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Term Notes. After deducting discounts and issuance costs, we received net proceeds of $ 497 million, which were used to repay a portion of the outstanding debt under the Delayed Draw Credit Agreement. The 2026 Term Notes, which mature on September 9, 2026, accrue interest at a rate of 4.650 % per annum, payable semi-annually on March 9 and September 9 of each year, beginning on March 9, 2025. We may redeem for cash all or any portion of the 2026 Term Notes, at our option, at any time prior to maturity at make-whole premium redemption prices as defined in the form of the notes. 5.800 % Term Notes due 2025 (2025 Term Notes) and 5.750 % Term Notes due 2027 (2027 Term Notes) In December 2022, we issued $ 500 million aggregate principal amount of 2025 Term Notes and $ 500 million aggregate principal amount of 2027 Term Notes. The 2025 Term Notes matured and were repaid in cash on December 12, 2025. The 2027 Term Notes, which mature on December 13, 2027, accrue interest at a rate of 5.750 % per annum, payable semi-annually on June 13 and December 13 of each year, beginning in June 2023. We may redeem for cash all or any portion of the 2027 Term Notes, at our option, at any time prior to maturity. Prior to November 13, 2027, the notes are redeemable at make-whole premium redemption prices as defined in the form of the notes. After November 13, 2027, the notes are redeemable at a redemption price equal to 100 % of the principal to be redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest up to, but excluding, the redemption date.

credit_strengths.text: Illumina's operating cash flow has strengthened materially across the trend, funding capex and leaving substantial free cash flow that covers debt service comfortably. The shift from operating losses to solid operating income signals a genuine earnings recovery, and cash generation now anchors the credit profile rather than balance-sheet liquidity alone.

Gross leverage sits below the sector median and net leverage is negligible once cash is netted, placing the issuer in a minimal indicative financial risk profile. Liquidity is ample, with the current ratio above the sector median, and the Altman Z double-prime zone reads safe, supporting a strong investment-grade-like profile.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a term note maturing within the next twelve months, classified as current, alongside another maturity shortly after. Refinancing this near-term obligation depends on continued cash generation or market access, and the disclosed make-whole redemption features could make early retirement costly if the issuer chooses to prepay.

Revenue has declined modestly across the trend while operating income swung from losses to profit, indicating margin recovery is doing the heavy lifting. If revenue pressure persists, the earnings base supporting coverage could erode, and the disclosed risk factors highlight competitive and reimbursement pressures that could weigh on instrument and consumable demand.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is solid and free cash flow to debt is strong, comfortably above the sector median, indicating the issuer can service obligations from internally generated funds. Operating cash flow covers capex many times over, and the resulting free cash flow provides a substantial buffer against earnings volatility.

With cash exceeding reported debt on a net basis, the issuer holds a net cash position, and the indicative profile is minimal. However, the debt figure is a partial instrument-tag sum and excludes lease liabilities, so true obligations are somewhat higher; this data gap is material to a precise leverage assessment.

overall_credit_view.text: Illumina presents a strong credit profile: minimal indicative financial risk, net cash after short-term investments, and cash flow that comfortably covers debt service. Leverage is below the sector median and coverage is adequate, though slightly below the sector median, suggesting some relative earnings weakness despite the improved trend.

The near-term maturity is manageable given free cash flow and cash balances, but refinancing risk warrants monitoring. Shareholder returns absorb a meaningful portion of free cash flow, which could constrain deleveraging if earnings soften. Overall, the credit is sound with a stable outlook, subject to revenue stabilization and prudent maturity management.

credit_strengths.text: Illumina 的營運現金流在整個趨勢中顯著增強，足以支應資本開支，並留下可觀的自由現金流，從容覆蓋債務償付。由營運虧損轉為穩健的營運收入，顯示盈利真正復甦，而現金產生現已成為信用狀況的支柱，而非僅依賴資產負債表流動性。
總槓桿低於行業中位數，而計入現金後淨槓桿微不足道，使發行人處於極低的指示性財務風險狀況。流動性充裕，流動比率高於行業中位數，而 Altman Z 雙質數區間讀數為安全，支持強勁的類投資級狀況。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露一筆將於未來十二個月內到期的定期票據，分類為流動負債，另有另一筆緊隨其後到期。為此短期債務再融資取決於持續的現金產生或市場准入，而所披露的 make-whole 贖回條款可能使提前償還成本高昂，若發行人選擇提前還款。
收入在整個趨勢中溫和下降，而營運收入由虧損轉為盈利，顯示利潤率復甦承擔了主要作用。若收入壓力持續，支持覆蓋率的盈利基礎可能受侵蝕，而所披露的風險因素凸顯競爭及報銷壓力，可能拖累儀器及耗材需求。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率穩健，自由現金流對債務比率強勁，舒適地高於行業中位數，顯示發行人能以內部產生的資金償付債務。營運現金流覆蓋資本開支多倍，而由此產生的自由現金流為盈利波動提供可觀緩衝。
由於現金淨額超過報告債務，發行人持有淨現金狀況，而指示性狀況為極低。然而，債務數字為部分工具標籤總和，不包括租賃負債，因此真實債務略高；此數據缺口對精確槓桿評估屬重大。

overall_credit_view.text: Illumina 呈現強勁的信用狀況：極低的指示性財務風險、短期投資後的淨現金，以及從容覆蓋債務償付的現金流。槓桿低於行業中位數，覆蓋率充足，儘管略低於行業中位數，顯示儘管趨勢改善，仍存在若干相對盈利疲弱。
鑑於自由現金流及現金結餘，短期到期債務可控，但再融資風險值得監控。股東回報吸收自由現金流的可觀部分，若盈利轉弱，可能限制去槓桿。整體而言，信用穩健，展望穩定，取決於收入穩定及審慎的到期債務管理。
